status: Experimental changed search and aggregate effort policy; not a speed or optimality claim
mechanism: Each negotiation owns a copied, deeply frozen physical SRJ and route input. Privately constructed fixed routes are deeply frozen and registered under an append-only epoch. Exact typed task fingerprints select bounded retained Bellman fields. Unknown graph edges use geometric cost; a blocked edge requires naturally observed fresh hard-geometry rejection in both orientations, not two hits of the native unordered cache. Partial Bellman backups improve the next search's frozen heuristic view.
relaxation: The native finite grid, eight planar neighbors and allowed electrical layer transitions are retained. Movable-copper prices and path drill history are omitted from the lower-bound field. All live costs, hard geometry, full-span/blind via semantics, same-net distinct drills, terminal anchors and path history remain authoritative in the fresh native planner. Goal connectors retain optimistic geometric bounds until the native planner checks them.
sourceLimits: This is partial Bellman lower-bound learning, not a complete implementation of Lifelong-GLS or an exact shortest-path theorem for native one-label weighted A* with drill history. Binary64 backups use downward cost-rounding slack; physical clearance thresholds are unchanged.
effort: Original native heap-pop/call/region caps remain. A new aggregate allowance, numerically equal to the regional heap-pop allowance, pays native heap pops plus every added owned-value copy/validation, task fingerprint, fixed-route guard, grid validation, graph construction, predecessor scan, Bellman update, queue operation/compaction, retained-state release and output copy. Existing native geometry calls are counted separately rather than charged twice. These work units are not CPU-equivalent, and literal cap equality is not equal effort.
unknown: Aggregate exhaustion or an unsupported retained-grid domain yields a named bounded unknown using the native node-limit completion shape. Before owned initialization, negotiation fully charges and reserves a private mutable rollback snapshot, assigning it only after copying completes. Later aggregate UNKNOWN returns that snapshot without any post-cap copy, preserving geometry/identity despite caller mutation. If the snapshot copy itself cannot finish, preOwnershipUnknowns explicitly reports that caller-isolation has not begun and the original caller input is returned; no owned-scene result is claimed. No alternate search engine or previous solved route is substituted. Existing whole-board physical/reference publication guards are retained.
memory: At most 64 task/domain workspaces, 16384 retained node/rejection entries per workspace, and 2000000 signature characters per workspace. Pending queues compact paid prefixes. These are logical storage bounds, not measured RSS or actual Map allocation sizes. Native grid storage is unchanged; the retained domain is limited to 1000000 nodes with exact coordinate round trips.
validation: Independent finite-graph distance oracle, one-sided/asymmetric observations, immutable ownership/value changes, price increases/decreases omitted by construction, native whole-segment witness replay, drill/layer/rotated-pad copy parity, bounded unknowns, and unchanged exact-fit/private-incomplete-candidate tests. Actual captured-region operation probes and limits are stored outside the checkout. Performance validation is Blacksmith-only.
